data: What is the accuracy of the blue line representing top-1 using GenCorpus when DicEx+WO is used?

The question asks for the accuracy of the blue line representing top-1 using GenCorpus when DicEx+WO is used. From the caption, we know that the blue line represents Top-1 using GenCorpus. The x-axis shows different corpora and their combinations, and the y-axis shows accuracy. The point where the x-axis is labeled 'DicEx+WO' corresponds to the accuracy value on the y-axis. By examining the graph, the accuracy of the blue line at this point appears to be approximately 35%.
